spans.s:
n. (-णं)
Sky, atmosphere, heaven.
E.
गम to go, Uṇādi affix, युच्, and the radical final changed to ग; the word and its derivatives are also sometimes read गगन.

m. (-जः)
1 A cloud.
2 The sun.
E.
गगण the sky, and ध्वज a standard or symbol.

m. (-गः)
1 The sun.
2 A planet.
3 A heavenly spirit.
E.
गगण the sky, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.

m. (-ष्पः)
A flower in the sky, i. e. an impossibility.
E.
गगण and पुष्प a flower; also गगणकुसुम, &c.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Sporting in heaven.
m. (-री)
1 The sun.
2 A heavenly luminary.
3 A divinity or celestial being.
E.
गगण, and विहारिन् who sports.

mf. (-सत् or सद्)
Going in the air.
m. (-सद्)
A celestial being.
E.
गगण, and षद to go, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Situated in the sky.
E.
गगण, and स्थ what stays in; also गगणस्थित, &c.

m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
E.
गगण, and स्पर्शन who touches.

n. (-ग्रं)
The highest heavens, the summit or highest part of heaven.
E.
गगण, and अग्र end.

m. (-रः)
1 A planet.
2 An asterism.
3 A heavenly spirit.
E.
गगणे in the sky, चर who goes.

m. (-कः)
The planet Mars.
E.
गगण the sky, and उल्मका, a torch or coal.

r. 1st cl. (गग्घति)
To laugh, to laugh at or deride: see घग्घ.
